label: North Branch Baddeck River confluence centre at Baddeck Forks

reference_mouth_midpoint.method: EPSG3857 midpoint of original northern/southern mouth bank vertices, transformed back to lonlat; project-derived centre because source depicts single channels.

identity_evidence: The source labels Baddeck Forks. The northern/western tributary passes the New Glen valley and meanders to join the northeast main Baddeck River; the combined river then curves south past the McRae/Jones properties toward the later Baddeck Bridge crossing. The selected point is the single-line water junction, not the road intersection or bridge northwest of it. Original named North Branch banks181337/159474 terminate on the western bank of Baddeck River156465/156466. Their mouth centre matches the historical single-channel definition. Gazetteer coordinates located the vicinity but were not used as the reference.
phase: Prospective interior control selected before evaluating model effect; never a fresh check
